purpose: Prevent visual formula decisions from being promoted without mobile evidence once device profiling starts.
scenarios: Valoria formula overview at official zoom 12
promotion_rules: Do not lower visual quality pre-emptively without measured mobile evidence.
Do not raise texture or geometry budgets solely because desktop performance is acceptable.
Compare the same scenario and camera before/after any optimization.
Prefer fixing the measured bottleneck rather than applying broad optimizations blindly.

thresholds.note: No FPS, memory or triangle limit is canonical until measured on representative target hardware.

desktop_editor_baseline.scenario: Valoria production overview with west rebuilders quarter + grounded Bastion crowns
desktop_editor_baseline.note: Current real Unity editor/capture scene-complexity baseline. This is not a mobile FPS/memory threshold. Compare target-device profiling against this exact scenario before any quality reduction.

sequence: Build the same current production scenario for a representative target phone.
Measure official zoom 12 overview, west rebuilders district pan, Aserradero+Cuartel together, and Bastion/hero view.
Record FPS/frame time, peak memory, texture memory when available, batches/draw calls when available, resolution, quality profile and thermal/sustained-run notes.
Derive SUPPORT / PRIMARY / HERO budgets from the measured bottleneck and compare against the first-district 460,236-triangle baseline.
If the device result is healthy, preserve current visual quality and scale cautiously; if not, optimize only the measured bottleneck.

desktop_editor_baseline_history.note: This is a real Unity editor/capture scene-complexity baseline, not a target-device performance result. It must be used as the before-state for mobile profiling, not as an FPS or memory threshold.
